贤者的遗志说明：全游戏共 20 个贤者的遗志（Sage's Will），分布于天空群岛的宝箱中，每位贤者对应 5 个。收集后可在神庙内的雕像处兑换，每 4 个可提升一位贤者的能力等级（最高 2 级）。部分遗志需要击败特定 Boss（方块魔像 II/III、王者古栗欧克）才能开启宝箱，其余通过解谜或直接开箱获得。坐标说明：游戏内按 M 打开地图，右下角显示当前坐标（X, Y, Z）。天空群岛 Z 高度通常在 800 以上。

Sage's Will guide: There are 20 Sage's Wills in total across the game, found in chests on the Sky Islands. Once collected, they can be exchanged at the statue inside a shrine; every 4 will raise one Sage's ability level (max level 2). Some wills require defeating a specific boss (Flux Construct II/III, King Gleeok) before the chest can be opened; the rest are obtained by solving puzzles or opening chests directly. Coordinates: in game, press M to open the map; your current coordinates (X, Y, Z) appear in the bottom-right corner. Sky Islands usually sit at a Z height above 800.

击败方块魔像II，宝箱从其身上掉落
Defeat Flux Construct II; the chest drops from it.
使用矿车穿越轨道后开箱
Ride a mine cart across the tracks, then open the chest.
球形岛内操控入口朝下，用通天术进入后开箱
Inside the spherical island, turn the entrance to face down, then enter with Ascend and open the chest.
球形旋转天空岛，停止旋转后进入下层开箱
On the rotating spherical sky island, stop its rotation, then enter the lower level and open the chest.
击败王者古栗欧克后，南侧祭坛宝箱解锁
After defeating King Gleeok, the chest at the southern altar unlocks.
用镜子反射阳光点亮六边形面板，开启锁门宝箱
Use mirrors to reflect sunlight onto the hexagonal panels to open the locked-door chest.
星望岛内用镜子反射光线点亮面板，开启宝箱
Inside Starview Island, use mirrors to reflect light onto the panels to open the chest.
击败方块魔像III，宝箱从其身上掉落
Defeat Flux Construct III; the chest drops from it.
南海布拉天空群岛废墟中央，直接开箱
In the center of the South Hebra Sky Archipelago ruins, open the chest directly.
北塔班达天空群岛西侧岛屿，直接开箱
On the western island of the North Tabantha Sky Archipelago, open the chest directly.
雷鸣岛，用弹射器发射后破石取箱
On Thunderhead Isles, launch yourself with the launcher, then break the stone to reach the chest.
龙首岛西北角祭坛，直接开箱
At the altar in the northwest corner of Dragonhead Island, open the chest directly.
双水池岛，用究极手抬起闸门排水后开箱
On the twin-pool island, use Ultrahand to lift the sluice gate and drain the water, then open the chest.
北奈克鲁达天空群岛发光石岛屿，直接开箱
On the Luminous Stone island of the North Necluda Sky Archipelago, open the chest directly.
涌泉岛，击败方块魔像II后开箱
On Wellspring Island, open the chest after defeating Flux Construct II.
